profile.name: Cito Plus 1310 射频发生器
profile.description: 这是一台射频发生器，用于向实验装置或工艺负载提供可调射频功率，并监测正向功率、反射功率和负载功率等状态。适合需要稳定射频激励与功率控制的实验和设备集成场景。
profile.description_en: This is an RF generator that provides adjustable radio-frequency power to an experimental system or process load, while monitoring forward, reflected, and load power. It is suited for laboratory and equipment-integration use cases that require stable RF excitation and controlled power delivery.

registry.name: CITO Plus 1310nm Laser
registry.description: CITO Plus 1310nm Laser Module是由CEM Corporation生产的表征设备，主要功能包括加载。支持Signal, Slot, forward power等操作。
